AUDIT QUESTION: Batch 41 cycle 3 (verification) = PROTECTED REFERENCE references/pulse_moments_2026-11-12 (orchestrator order 2026-11-12 '20:30' (c)). Its small files (SHA256SUMS among them) are tracked in git and pinned by annotated tag ref-pulse-moments-2026-11-12; its videos and other large files are untracked, read-only, and listed with their sha256 in SHA256SUMS. pipeline/regression.sh step 7 (runs under set -euo pipefail) after cycle 2 (deepseek: a deleted reference was read as SKIP; an edited SHA256SUMS went undetected): SKIP only when this checkout neither tracks references/pulse_moments_2026-11-12/SHA256SUMS (git ls-files --error-unmatch) nor has the directory; otherwise check_reference_manifest.py must exit 0 (every listed file present with its sha256, nothing unlisted; exit 2 = no manifest, which now FAILS here) AND `git diff --quiet ref-pulse-moments-2026-11-12 -- references/pulse_moments_2026-11-12` must hold (tracked files equal to the tag). Proven on a throwaway repo: intact 0; a file changed with SHA256SUMS re-made to match 1; the directory deleted 1; an untracked checkout SKIP 0.
FIND: any remaining way the regression passes while the reference is changed, deleted or replaced, or fails on an intact reference; shell errors silently ignored. Reply with the JSON verdict; keep the reasoning short; at most 3 findings.
